blocks.text: The duplicates Megan described account for the difference between the reserve detail and your year-end figure. With the second copy of each pair set aside, the two agree within rounding. That result is preliminary until your team confirms how the extract was run.
The steps, so that your staff can check them:

1. I totaled the reserve detail as received and compared it with the year-end figure in your financial records. The detail was higher.
2. I matched records on identifier and reserve amount. Every pair matched on both and differed only in the extract date.
3. With one copy of each pair removed, the remaining difference is within rounding.

I have entered the adjusted file in our data log for {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} as provisional and used it for this check only. Nothing from it goes into the reserve model until the double run is confirmed.
